title: Review Vulkan SM6 cafeteria cook verification artifacts
objective: Review the Experimenter verification artifacts for the clean cafeteria Linux Vulkan SM6 hardware RT cook/package. Confirm the package verification is sufficient to state that the recooked package contains VULKAN_SM6 shader artifacts and is not SM5-only. Also confirm whether the runtime validation limitation is accurately described as headless DISPLAY/WAYLAND only.
instructions: Review the artifacts only; do not run another cook or runtime launch.
Look for positive proof of VULKAN_SM6: shader autogen, SF_VULKAN_SM6 compile jobs, GlobalShaderCache-VULKAN_SM6.bin in pak/listing. Look for negative/contradictory SM5-only signatures.
Assess whether it is accurate to tell the user the package is now SM6/RT-ready but live runtime must be run from a display-capable session.

artifacts: Clean Linux cafeteria cook/package on 2026-07-08 succeeded with Vulkan SM6 hardware RT config; archive pak contains Engine/GlobalShaderCache-VULKAN_SM6.bin and checked artifacts showed no SM5-only shader signatures.
Runtime live validation still needs a display-capable session; current shell has empty DISPLAY and WAYLAND_DISPLAY.

expected_outputs: Approval or blocker findings with artifact path/line references.
Exact user runtime command and expected log signatures if approved.
definition_of_done: Inspector states whether Tower can report the SM6 package verification as approved.
